Title: Cancelling an added daily values collected

Step Action: Log in to the app with user "support" and password "renal"
Select patient 1018 with the patients searching option
Click on "Hospitalization" button in the main menu
Select the hospitalization to be modified and enter the daily values collected section
Click on "New" button
Complete the necessary data:
Date  (today's date is suggested by the system). Required field
Click on "Cancel" button
The system shall not save the new daily values collected
Log in to the app with user "support" and password "renal"
Select patient 1018 with the patients searching option
Click on "Hospitalization" button in the main menu
Select the hospitalization to be modified and enter the daily values collected section
Click on "New" button
Complete the necessary data:
Date  (today's date is suggested by the system). Required field

Title: Add daily values collected with empty required fields

Step Action: Log in to the app with user "support" and password "renal"
Select patient 1018 with the patients searching option
Click on "Hospitalization" button in the main menu
Select the hospitalization to be modified and enter the daily values collected section
Click on "New" button
Leave the required fields empty:
- Date
Click on "Save" button
Warning: The date is required
Click on "OK" button
The system shall not allow to save the daily values collected
